mode_meaning.contaminated: Team inputs are season-to-date leaderboards, so every graded game sits inside its own features. This measures calibration, not skill, and it cannot validate anything.
mode_meaning.vintage: Every game is priced on a leaderboard snapshot whose knowledge cutoff is strictly before that game: team offense, team run prevention, the listed probable and the park index all come out of that snapshot. A game with no such snapshot is skipped, not graded on today's numbers, and a game whose snapshot predates the stored park column is priced with the park term at neutral rather than on the live index. This is the only mode that can validate the model.

rules.when: two or more legs from the same game
rules.why: Same-game outcomes share the run environment, the starters and the weather. Multiplying the legs is not arithmetic, it is an assumption, and it is wrong.

rules.when: moneyline and runline on the same team
rules.why: The runline is a subset of the moneyline. These are one bet with two prices, not two bets, and the product is meaningless.

rules.when: a moneyline and the total in the same game
rules.why: Favourite plus under and dog plus over are both positively correlated. The naive product is too cheap.

rules.when: two player props from the same lineup
rules.why: Teammates share innings and baserunners. Hits and total bases on the same night rise and fall together.

rules.when: a starter strikeout prop with that team's moneyline
rules.why: A dominant start moves both. Correlated legs price differently than the product suggests.

parlay_context.featured_reason: A featured parlay needs a backtest that survives the correlation haircut. There is not one, so there is no featured parlay.
parlay_context.math_note: Independent legs multiply. Same-game legs do not, and the naive product is always too generous to the bettor's story and too cheap for the book to sell at that price.

record_policy: Append only. Rows are never edited or deleted; a correction is a new row. betting_export.write_record refuses any other write and test_betting.py pins it.
